verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Release Pipelines with stage triggers and actions, percentage rollouts, a manual kill switch, and an experimentation stats engine. Nothing documents metric-based guardrails that detect a regression and roll back a release automatically. Pipeline triggers are never described as metric-driven, and the kill switch is a manual disable, so both are adjacent features rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can guard a rollout with metrics so a regression is detected and the release is rolled back automatically
